scientific_integrity: Standalone proof and exact checker supplied; independent mathematical and publication-priority audits not performed.
scientific_limitations: For multiplicity-two flattened Stirling permutations only. The finite sum relies on a known bijection and is neither a simple product nor an arbitrary-multiplicity extension. Previously known descent-number distributions are not claimed as new.
title: Exact descent-set enumeration of flattened Stirling permutations
